money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 4 May 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 4 May 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.56%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 4 May 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 5 May 2026 (its PL IRS table repeats the 30 Apr levels with zero changes: 4 May was a UK bank holiday and the LSEG PL IRS feed was not updated; no clean 4 May levels exist, so the 30 Apr close is carried and ASW are measured against it; FRA, CDS and spread are 4 May reads) (table headed 30.04.2026 (carried); only the 4 May 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 4 May 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 4 May 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 4 May 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.70% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (PS1026 3.72%, OK0127 3.68%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 30 Apr 2026 (holdings and statistics as of 27 Apr 2026; published 28 Apr 2026, PDF CreationDate 28 Apr 15:38 CEST, HTTP Last-Modified 28 Apr 17:47 CEST). Changes: PS0731 enters TBSP and B5Y; WS0429 enters B1Y3Y (leaves B3Y5Y); WZ1126 leaves BWZ. Units match MoF settlements to 27 Apr (sales of 15 and 23 Apr).
